title: Cute little find
text: Cute little find. I love this cute landscape. It is unique and fits in nicely with the feel of my spare bedroom. I like that the frame and hanger are metal and the landscape its self is on a canvas and feels much more expensive than it was.

product_metadata.title: Creative Co-Op Modern Metal Framed Landscape Art with Hanging Bracket Wall Décor, Multicolored, 11.75" x 14.50"
features: Give your bedroom, hallway, or living room decorations a charming update with this beautiful wall art; featuring a painting-style, landscape image of a river, it will be a wonderful addition to your home decor
This bedroom decor has a strong and durable iron and MDF construction; the oversized, circular hanging bracket attached to it allows it to be hung in a uniquely stylish fashion

This living room decor is an amazing choice for accenting a modern or contemporary design scheme; it looks splendid displayed above a couch and paired with a large planter filled with decorative stems
Gift this wall hanging decor as a housewarming, wedding anniversary, or Thanksgiving present to a family member or dear friend
Measuring 11.75" in width and 14.5" H, this wall art for living room gives you a compact way to enhance the decor
description: This metal framed wall art offers a seamless blend of charm and sophistication for your home or office decor. It features a painting-style image of a river and a large, round decorative bracket. Whether displayed alone or as part of a gallery wall, this hanging decor easily enhances the room’s visual appeal. It looks especially great as part of modern wall decorations for the living room, hallway, or bedroom. Create a striking look by pairing it with an elegant couch and a tall planter filled with large decorative stems. With its serene imagery, this art painting is a wonderful choice as a gift for family or friends, no matter the occasion.
